title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Oosthuizen Withdraws from Open
items.text: 2010 Open leader Louis Oosthuizen withdrew from the 2026 Open Championship at Royal Birkdale due to a back injury, with his spot going to 21-year-old LIV golfer Aldrich Potgieter.

items.headline: Woods Delays Return for Personal Reasons
items.text: Tiger Woods put golf on hold while supporting his girlfriend, Vanessa Trump, through breast cancer and ongoing court issues, making a 2027 comeback the earliest possibility.

items.headline: Korda and Ryu Dominate LPGA Majors
items.text: Nelly Korda and Haeran Ryu each leads two LPGA majors in 2026, the first golfers to do so in the same calendar year, marking a defining season in women's golf.
